why: On 30 Sep 2026 Jeremy Soller said COSMIC would no longer accept LLM-written code, comments, or PR text because first-time LLM submissions were unplanned and rarely accepted. cosmic-epoch itself had 23 PRs in the year; cosmic-comp is the compositor and had 425. The pop-os org had 4363 PRs in the same window.
population_note: Search totals from 2026-10-22. Not a census, and not a count of bad patches.
